liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Morning Dew** (1 review): Listener highlights Jerry's unique, risky solo in Morning Dew, contrasting his playing with his poor appearance [48]

## The recordings

- **gd1984-10-12.143086.schoeps.sterry.beckwith.miller.clugston.flac1648** (recommended): audience recording; 20 songs; 141 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1984-10-12.176001.senn441.blend.eaton.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 18 songs; 153 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [6]
- **gd84-10-12.sbd.clugston.5585.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 139 min; rated 4.17/5 by 36 [11]. Said about its sound: SBD lacks the resonance and sustained notes of audience recordings, where high end snuck underneath [44]
- **gd1984-10-12.148413.fob.neumann.km84i.hecht.miller.clugston.flac1648**: audience recording; 18 songs; 144 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [16]
- **gd84-10-12-oade.sacks.8795.sbefail.shnf**: source not stated; 18 songs; 139 min; rated 4.51/5 by 41 [23]. Said about its sound: Listener describes the Oade recording as having a perfect, immersive presence in the venue [38]
- **gd84-10-12.beyer-ficca.ficca.20022.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 19 songs; 133 min; rated 4.27/5 by 11 [25]. Said about its sound: Beyer-Ficca AUD has more high end and beefier levels than the Oade recording, though the SBD is preferred [42]

## Around the show
